QUICK ANSWERS

Before we
get started.

How much does a website cost?+

Every quote reflects the scope, features, content and level of customisation required. Share your requirements and we will recommend a suitable approach.

Do you work with businesses outside India?+

Yes. Projects can be planned and reviewed remotely, with communication and delivery agreed before work begins.

What should I provide for a website?+

Your business information, services, logo, approved photographs, contact details and examples of websites you like. We will guide you through the exact checklist.

Can you also edit our social content?+

Yes. Reels, montages, promotional videos and client-story edits can be handled as a separate or ongoing service.

Will the website work well on mobile?+

Responsive behaviour is considered from the beginning, including readable layouts, touch-friendly controls and lightweight assets.

How long does a website take?+

Timing depends on the number of pages, features and how ready the content is. Your proposal will confirm a practical schedule before work begins.

Who owns the website and domain?+

Ownership, hosting and handover are written clearly into the proposal. Wherever practical, the domain and key accounts should stay in the client’s name and control.
